messages:
Alex: Quick sketch — want a sankey that shows token-level latency flowing across phases: enqueue -> batch_wait -> kernel_exec -> kv_lookup. Weight edges by milliseconds not just token count so slow tokens stand out. Sketch: https://not-a-real-link/figma/sankey

Priya: love it. two infra requests: ensure `x-rid` is propagated end-to-end, and add `token.kernel_id` + `token.kv_hit` tags on token emission. otherwise deep-links are useless.

Dan: flagged a regression this morning: p95 token latency for /chat/completions up ~120ms. local trace shows a KV miss storm and batch sizes fell to 1. we also had a kernel fallback to f32. dropping sample trace x-rid: rid_20260317_22a1

Marta: UI idea: show kernel-switch as a vertical marker over the sankey and split flows by batch_size buckets (1,2-8,9+). clicking an edge filters to kernel_id + kv_hit state and opens a request list.

infra-bot: deploy-notify: visualization/ui#678 deployed to staging (experiment: latency-sankey). CI job 412 passed :white_check_mark:

Oliver: two visualization notes: 1) normalize sankey magnitudes per-route so tiny routes don't disappear 2) overlay p50/p95/p99 token latency as small sparkline above each route card.

Alex: instrumentation plan draft:
- emit token tags: `token.kernel_id`, `token.kv_hit`, `x-rid` at ingress
- record micro-timings per-token: enqueue_ms, batch_wait_ms, kernel_ms, kv_ms (histogram buckets) per-route
- kernel_switch events as spans with before/after kernel_id and memory/alloc state
- metric exports: per-route avg_batch_size, tokens/s, kv_hit_rate, kernel_switch_rate
- dashboard: sankey + per-request drilldown linking to trace view via x-rid

Priya: starting PR to runtime to add tags & passthrough: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1024. also adding kernel_id -> human label mapping in trace processor so UI shows "kernel: q8fn-v2".

Dan: posted allocator logs: when GPU mem usage hit ~92% allocator disabled a few fused kernels, triggered fallback path. filing bug INF-3124. sample log:
```
[2026-03-17T03:41:12Z] alloc_manager: mem_pct=92.3 disable_fused_kernels=true fallback_kernel=q_f32_v1
[2026-03-17T03:41:12Z] runtime: batch_size=1 kernel_id=q_f32_v1 kv_hit=false
```

Marta: UX flow: sankey columns = phases, controls for normalization (absolute/ms vs proportion), batch-size facet, time window (1h/24h/7d). clicking an edge -> request list -> single-request token timeline with per-token spans (enqueue, wait, kernel, kv).

Oliver: KPI cards to add on route page: tokens/s, avg_batch_size, kv_hit_rate, kernel_switch_rate, p50/p95/p99 token latency. all queryable over rolling windows.

Alex: also want an "incident correlate" widget: when p95 deviates +X% show top N x-rids that contributed, grouped by kernel_id and kv_hit. helps go from metric anomaly -> traces quickly.

Priya: PR opened, test coverage added for tag propagation. will add trace-processor mapping for kernel labels tomorrow.

Dan: INF-3124 created, adding timeline and traces to the ticket. dropping x-rid sample for the spike: rid_20260317_22a1 (same as above).

Marta: prototyping sankey interactions in staging, will upload screenshots when ready. expect initial review in 24-48h.

Alex: plan for next sync: validate end-to-end linking (metric -> sankey edge -> request list -> trace) with Dan's sample x-rid. Priya, can you confirm tag presence in the trace export by EOD?

Priya: yes, I'll validate emission and post a trace snippet here once verified. :thumbsup:

Oliver: tiny perf ask: add `avg_batch_size` as a series next to tokens/s so ops can correlate throughput changes with batching collapse.

Alex: perfect. thanks team. If anyone has other sample traces or odd kernel ids that popped up during the spike, drop them here or attach x-rid. We'll do a dry run of the sankey -> trace flow tomorrow morning. :coffee:
